description:
With the new codegen in place (T2), the ~F sigil no longer requires assigns in lexical scope. Remove every workaround that existed to satisfy that requirement, and tighten render function signatures across all example components. READ FIRST: - lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (confirm no assigns reference is generated after T2) - examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex - examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/filter_bar.ex - examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_item.ex - test/filament/fixtures/counter_component.ex (check for assigns usage in test fixtures) - test/ (grep for assigns = to find any test fixtures that need cleanup) CHANGES REQUIRED: 1. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex REMOVE: assigns = {} (line exists before the ~F block — delete it entirely) The render function head is: def render(%{store: store, title: title}) do This is correct — no changes to the function head needed. 2. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/filter_bar.ex The render function currently takes `assigns` and uses Map.get to extract fields. Simplify to pattern match: CHANGE: def render(assigns) do ... filters = Map.get(assigns, :filters) ... TO: def render(%{filters: filters, on_change: on_change, default: default}) do Remove all Map.get calls. Access the extracted variables directly. 3. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_item.ex The render function currently uses def render(%{todo: todo} = assigns) do CHANGE: def render(%{todo: todo} = assigns) do TO: def render(%{todo: todo, on_toggle: on_toggle, on_remove: on_remove}) do Inside the template, replace @on_toggle and @on_remove with on_toggle and on_remove. Replace @todo.text and @todo.completed with todo.text and todo.completed. No assigns in scope after this change — the ~F must compile without it. 4. Scan test/filament/fixtures/ for any component that uses assigns = {} or = assigns in render functions. Apply the same cleanup: pattern match props directly, no assigns binding needed. 5. Add a compilation test: write a test that defines a minimal component with def render(%{text: text}) do ~F"""
{text}
""" end and confirms it compiles and renders without assigns in scope. Place in test/filament/vnode_compiler_test.exs or similar. VERIFICATION: - grep -r "assigns = {}" lib/ examples/ test/ — must return no results - grep -r "= assigns" lib/ examples/ test/ -- must return no results (except genuine uses) - mix test passes ACCEPTANCE: - `mix test` passes - Chrome: localhost:4000 — full todo demo works: add, toggle, filter - The server must start with no compilation warnings about unused variables - No assigns = {} anywhere in the codebase
title: Remove assigns dependency from all components; clean up render function signatures
